findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_status · Private data: check_fit, suggest_models, compare_setups, get_node_log, submit_result, report_issue · Public sink: submit_result, report_issue · Destructive: check_fit, suggest_models.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_status · Private data: check_fit, suggest_models, compare_setups, get_node_log, submit_result, report_issue · Public sink: submit_result, report_issue · Destructive: check_fit, suggest_models

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_fit" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
